name: glide-for-github
description: Chrome extension that adds a Glide tab to GitHub PR pages, powered by Pierre

scripts.e2e: npm run build && DISPLAY=${DISPLAY:-:0} WAYLAND_DISPLAY= playwright test
scripts.e2e:headless: npm run build && PIERRE_E2E_HEADLESS=1 playwright test
scripts.perf: npm run build && PIERRE_PERF=1 DISPLAY=${DISPLAY:-:0} WAYLAND_DISPLAY= playwright test tests/e2e/perf.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:token: npm run build && DISPLAY=${DISPLAY:-:0} WAYLAND_DISPLAY= node scripts/token-setup.mjs
